cases.reason: Two differences the reader missed. (1) communication-reach by deferral: 2002 SR3 makes the inline invocation valid when the equivalent INVOKE is, and 2002 INVOKE SR9 admits a communication-section argument, which 2023 SR9 drops (Annex A names INVOKE SR9/SR11 as communication references). So in 2002 GR2 governs a statement whose inline invocation passes a CD-record item. Probe inlcd.cob at 2002: MOVE C1 :: "ECHO" (QN) TO W, where QN is in a record under an input CD, gives [QUEUE-ONE   ] (correct). (2) 2023 SR4 adds a ban on an ACTIVE-CLASS returning item, which 2002 SR4 lacks (2002 13.16.58.2 SR15 allows ACTIVE-CLASS in a method's linkage section). So a 2002-valid inline invocation of a method returning ACTIVE-CLASS, governed by GR2, is outside 2023. Probe inlac.cob: --std 2002 REJECTS it with COBOL2140 citing §2023:8.4.3.4.3 SR4, a compiler defect at 2002.
